ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, PA and PB are tangents to the circle $\odot O$ with points A and B as the points of tangency. AC is a diameter of $\odot O$. If $\angle BAC=25^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle P$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OB, \\
$\because$ PA, PB are the tangents to circle $O$ with A and B as the points of tangency, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle OAP = \angle OBP = 90^\circ$, \\
$\because$ $\angle BAC = 25^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOC = 50^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOB = 180^\circ - 50^\circ = 130^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle P = 360^\circ - 90^\circ - 90^\circ - 130^\circ = \boxed{50^\circ}$.

Apply the tangent-chord theorem at A: the angle between tangent PA and chord AB, namely ∠PAB, equals the angle in the opposite arc, ∠ACB = 65°.
